name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

eligibility.income_limit: EWS (up to Rs 3 Lakh/yr), LIG (Rs 3-6 Lakh/yr), MIG-I (Rs 6-12 Lakh/yr), MIG-II (Rs 12-18 Lakh/yr)
eligibility.other_conditions: Beneficiary family should not own a pucca house in their name anywhere in India. Female ownership is mandatory in EWS/LIG.

benefits: Interest subsidy on home loans (CLSS) up to Rs 2.67 lakhs, or direct financial assistance for house construction/enhancement.
application_process: Apply online on PMAY(U) MIS portal using Aadhaar.
Select the appropriate component (CLSS, ISSR, AHP, BLC).
Submit required documents and track assessment status.
